STS2_LINNEA_KEYWORD_ENCOURAGE.title: Encourage
STS2_LINNEA_KEYWORD_ENCOURAGE.descriptio: Increase Lumi’s damage by this amount. At the end of your turn, halve Encouragement (round down), then gain Block equal to the amount lost. When you gain Encouragement, add Lumi to your hand if it is absent from your combat deck.
STS2_LINNEA_KEYWORD_FOREKNOWLEDGE.title: Foreknowledge
STS2_LINNEA_KEYWORD_FOREKNOWLEDGE.descri: Reveal this many top cards in order; each draw spends 1 stack. Every 7 stacks gained lets you draw or exhaust the top card.
STS2_LINNEA_KEYWORD_EXCAVATE.title: Excavate
STS2_LINNEA_KEYWORD_EXCAVATE.description: Generate an unplayable, Retained Ore in your hand.
